## Highlights
### New
- On Mac, choose how long the pointer rests on the window's edge before a hidden sidebar comes out, from Instant to a second, in Settings › Appearance › Sidebar hover delay. It applies in a window and in full screen, and moving off the edge before then still keeps the sidebar hidden. - On Mac, choose how fast the sidebar slides in and out, when it shows from the window's edge and when you hide or dock it, from Snap, which puts it in place at once, to twice as slow as before, in Settings › Appearance › Sidebar slide time.
### Fixed
- The tab list a folder shows when you rest the pointer on it or hold it keeps its text readable with Material color set to Light or Dark. - On Mac, a click anywhere in the sidebar's address field opens it. Clicks above and below "Search or enter website", or an address shown on one line, used to do nothing.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
